identity.name: AssetGuard Pro
identity.description: A robust maintenance log system for restaurant assets, bridging physical inventory with digital tracking.

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-sm hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-sm font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-sm font-medium

badges.style: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold border

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for dropdowns

universal_guidelines: Use 'Chivo' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for serial numbers, asset IDs, and technical data.
Cards must have a sharp, industrial feel (rounded-sm).
Use color coding strictly for status: Emerald (Good), Orange (Warning), Red (Critical).
Forms must be dense and labeled clearly (top labels).
Mobile views must convert tables to stacked cards for readability.
Dashboard grid must follow the 'Bento' layout rules (mixed spans).
Never use gradients for backgrounds; stick to solid colors or subtle patterns.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states.

instructions_to_main_agent.font_setup: Import Chivo and Inter from Google Fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_overrides: Modify Shadcn components to use 'rounded-sm' instead of 'rounded-md' or 'rounded-lg' to match the industrial theme.
instructions_to_main_agent.chart_config: Use Recharts with the defined color palette for data visualization.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard_layout: Implement the dashboard using CSS Grid with 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6' and use col-span utilities for widget sizing.
instructions_to_main_agent.navigation: Create a responsive sidebar navigation that collapses on mobile.
